verdict.rationale: Supermemory ingests raw conversations, extracts memories from them, updates conversations incrementally via customId, and keeps user profiles current from all interactions. An agent can therefore recall context from prior sessions, but the evidence never documents an explicit per-session or per-thread summary feature. missing for 10: explicit session/thread summarization output, documented resume-from-last-conversation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off

citations.quote: Send any raw content to Supermemory — conversations, documents, files, URLs. We extract the memories automatically.
Use customId to update existing documents or conversations. When you send content with the same customId, Supermemory intelligently processes only what's new.
User profiles are **automatically maintained collections of facts about your users** that Supermemory builds from all their interactions.
No search needed — comprehensive user info always ready Profiles update as users interact with your system
